tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Current spot prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium in US dollars, per troy ounce and per gram, with the change for the day. Data from MeltValue.com.

tools.name: get_metal_price
tools.description: Current spot price of one precious metal in US dollars per troy ounce, gram and kilogram, with the change for the day. Data from MeltValue.com.

tools.name: calculate_melt_value
tools.description: Melt value in US dollars of an item made of gold, silver, platinum or palladium, from its weight and purity at the live spot price. Give purity as karat (gold, for example 14) or as fineness (for example 0.925 for sterling silver). Melt value is the metal content value; buyers pay a percentage of it

tools.name: get_coin_melt_value
tools.description: Melt value in US dollars of common US gold and silver coins at the live spot price, based on each coin's precious metal content. Collector value can be higher. Calculation by MeltValue.com.
